description: This source file defines the PageAgent class, which manages interactions with a web page in the context of the Playwright automation framework. It provides methods to perform tasks, extract data based on queries, and handle internal events related to page automation.

classes.name: PageAgent
classes.description: A class that acts as an interface to automate and interact with a web page, including performing expectations, data extraction, and resource management within the Playwright framework.
